Enum Class LogLevel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<LogLevel>
tij.jca.logging.LogLevel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<LogLevel>, Constable
public enum LogLevel extends Enum<LogLevel>
Severity levels supported by the logging API.

Each level has associated numeric severity. Higher values represent increasingly severe events. The severity values are used to determine whether a log entry meets the configured minimum logging level.

The levels, ordered from least to most severe, are: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, and FATAL.

Since:

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    DEBUG
    Diagnostic information useful for developers when investigating application behaviour.
    ERROR
    An error that indicates a failure while performing an operation.
    FATAL
    A critical error indicating that the application or a major component may no longer be able to operate correctly.
    INFO
    General information about normal application operation.
    TRACE
    Detailed diagnostic information, typically useful only when troubleshooting or developing the application.
    WARN
    An abnormal or potentially problematic condition that does not necessarily prevent the application from continuing.

    • isAtLeast

      public boolean isAtLeast(LogLevel other)
      Determines whether this level is at least as severe as the supplied level.

      For example, ERROR.isAtLeast(WARN) returns true, while DEBUG.isAtLeast(INFO) returns false.

      Parameters:
      other - level to compare against
      Returns:
      true if this level is at least as severe as other
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if other is null
